thread:
elaine: FYI — JIT created an org-admin for svc-deploy@partner.example.com, should only be service-deployer. tagging @raj @tom :eyes:
okta-bot: [ALERT] SAML JIT provision success for user: svc-deploy@partner.example.com, assertion_id=urn:okta:assertion:0a1b2c3
elaine: captured sanitized assertion fragment below:
```
<Attribute Name="roles">
  <AttributeValue>org-admin</AttributeValue>
  <AttributeValue>service-deployer</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="redwood:roles">
  <AttributeValue>service-deployer</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="email">svc-deploy@partner.example.com</Attribute>
```
raj: looks like a namespace collision. we have both `roles` and `redwood:roles`. which one are we honoring in JIT?
tom: current code picks the first matching attr ending in /roles$/i and then first value. codepath: `extractRolesFromAssertion(assertion)` — it doesn't prefer namespaced attrs. bug.
elaine: timeline: KMS key rotation completed ~2h prior. not saying related but flagging. audit logs for this JIT call are thin — no attribute-level decision recorded :lock:
sandra: is this an escalation (we gave org-admin) or a mapping mismatch where partner deliberately exported org-admin?
elaine: confirmed escalation. partner's generic `roles` claim contained org-admin from legacy AD groups. they should have exported only `redwood:roles`.
raj: quick mitigations:
- ask partner to stop sending generic `roles`, send `redwood:roles` only
- make our JIT prefer `redwood:roles` and dedupe values
- temporarily disable auto-JIT for impacted partners
Which is fastest?
tom: I can push a small hotfix to prefer `redwood:roles` and normalize/uniq values. ~30m to get a canary out. tiny diff + tests. recommend 5% canary.
elaine: I'll send guidance to partner now, snippet:
```
Attribute Statements (SAML):
  redwood:roles -> user.groups
  email -> user.email
  name -> user.firstName + ' ' + user.lastName
```
raj: also adding an audit event for role resolution: `audit.event = {action: 'saml_role_resolve', input_attributes: [...], chosen_attribute: 'redwood:roles', chosen_value: 'service-deployer'}`. We must not store raw assertion but need attribute-level evidence.
sandra: add regression/integration tests for both `roles` and `redwood:roles` present — assert `redwood:roles` wins and no elevation occurs for unrelated groups.
tom: patch snippet:
```
// prefer namespace-specific attribute
const ROLE_ATTR_PREFERRED = 'redwood:roles';
const attrs = parseAttributes(assertion);
let roles = attrs[ROLE_ATTR_PREFERRED] || attrs['roles'] || [];
roles = uniq(normalize(roles));
```
elaine: also can we require an identifier like `sub` or `eduPersonTargetedID` for JIT? partner assertions sometimes omit `email_verified`.
raj: making `email_verified` mandatory will break partners. short-term: require `unique_external_id` and block if absent. long-term: migrate to verified email requirement.
okta-bot: config change request OKTA-4571 created; partner replied: "we'll update later today" :+1:
oncall-bot: rollback window scheduled 2h post-deploy. auto-escalate if errors > 1% in canary.
sandra: detection rule — page if any JIT resolves to admin role AND requester not in admin whitelist. low FP risk, immediate guard.
elaine: +1. @security-automation add rule: `event.type == 'saml_role_resolve' && chosen_value in admin_roles && not in admin_whitelist -> page oncall`
security-automation: added alert to prod with 1m evaluation window. pager payload will include attribute names/values and chosen mapping evidence.
raj: postmortem bullets:
- root cause: attribute namespace collision + precedence bug in JIT
- contributing: partner exported generic `roles` via legacy mapping
- missing: insufficient audit events for mapping decisions
- mitigations: code patch (prefer namespaced), Okta mapping change, alert, JIT auto-provision rollback option
tom: deploying 5% canary now. monitoring latency/errors and the new alert. includes unit + integration tests simulating conflicting attributes.
elaine: filed incident INC-2026, triage doc: <https://redwood-internal/triage/INC-2026>
sandra: action items:
- elaine: confirm partner mapping change (OKTA-4571) — due EOD
- tom: deploy canary + tests — in progress
- raj: add audit event + detection rule — done
- security-automation: include evidence in pager — done
- oncall: standby to rollback if noise
elaine: thanks. will update when partner confirms mapping change. :lock:
